rationale: The candidate slide is a resolved, content-filled attempt and is not a blank shell, but it carries two concrete regressions against the locked spec and baseline family. First, the footer logo renders as lowercase wordmark 'designer' without the Designer Health logomark/icon that appears in every other slide in the family (including the baseline shell and reference slides), representing a clear brand/family drift. Second, the left hero block is missing the locked 'Pre-Seed SAFE' label as a styled badge and instead uses a small all-caps 'PRE-SEED ROUND' eyebrow, which diverges from the spec's explicit hero block copy ('$1.25M' + 'Pre-Seed SAFE' as a paired unit); the support stats row (2 key hires / 3 pilot sites / 18–20 months runway) is present but floated to the right column rather than anchored under the hero ask block as specified. These are not style preferences — the logo regression is a visible family break and the hero copy structure deviates from locked spec.
